items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: Joe and Jack would get out their horns and I'd get the bass fiddle and we'd play along with the old-fashioned piano.

ctx.x: This is September the 29th, 1956, and I'm at 815 Alleen Street, New Orleans, Louisiana, and I'm having an informal chat with Arnold Ayacana. Arnold, give me your full name. Is Arnold the whole business? No, it's Arnold Joseph Ayacana. And, of course, if you were a lady,

I wouldn't dare ask you this, but what's the date of your birth? Well, it's August 13th, 1889. Were you born in New Orleans? Born in New Orleans. What street, do you know? I was born on Magazine Street. Magazine in what? Near Thalia. And how many brothers and sisters did you have? Well, I had four brothers and three sisters. And how many are living today? Well, I have three brothers living, three brothers and sisters. And how many of that group were musical? Well, almost all of them played. Pretty many of them…
